main_body: Stove body: a slate hood/canopy over a grey vent panel and a brick firebox base, with a brick chimney stack above
top_band: Slate-grey hood top, rows 21-25 (lighter blue-grey at the top, darker below), sloped like a stall roof, ending in a dark eave at rows 26-27
evidence: A column through the middle reads as chimney brick (rows 8-20), then the hood top band (rows 21-25, lighter slate). A darker front edge and eave sit at rows 26-27 and shade the vent panel below. The panel (rows 28-35) and the brick base (rows 36-47) form the front face. The firebox is inset with a dark frame and glowing coals. The hood top is close to a roof band like the stall reference and it is thin, but it is a clearly separate horizontal surface above a distinct front face, so it passes narrowly.

style.evidence: The firebox has a good 4-5 step ember ramp, and the bricks have a few tones with dark mortar. The hood and vent panel are broad areas of 2-3 slate tones with no tile, grain or speckle, so they are flat fills. The outline is a dark purple-brown beside the bricks but nearly neutral dark grey around the hood, so it is mixed. Overall the piece is thinner and flatter than the reference stall and well, which have per-tile highlights and grain.
